_evidence: Car block at esi for 0x0040f06c (overlay on rec_0040ee7b): 'movzx ecx,byte [esi+0x7c]; and ecx,0x3f; dec ecx; cmp ecx,0x15; jle' only clamps the index from above, then the dwords +0x34/+0x2c/+0x30 are stored at [ecx*4+0x675970/0x6759c8/0x675a20] and 'mov al,[esi+0x7c]; cmp al,[0x675958]' compares the whole byte with the first order-list byte after the callee sort 0x52286e. The byte is a car number with flag bits: the order list 0x675958 holds the same bytes and the sort keys are indexed by (b & 0x3f) - 1 into the 22-entry key table, so the low six bits are 1..22 in the game (and 23/63 reach the clamp). Low bits 0 give index -1: the key store lands on 0x67596c, i.e. on order-list bytes 20/21 themselves, after which the bubble sort reads keys that its own swaps change and never terminates (the observed 1/200 timeout) - no car has number 0, so that value is excluded. +0x34 is the sort key written for this car: the sort is ascending (swap when key[i+1] < key[i]), so 0x80000000 (and small values) let this car sort to the head of the list, which reaches the equality block; +0x2c/+0x30 are copied only.
